allowlist: <guest tar> (built from the litebox guest manifest: command ELF + deps + allowlist, read-only inside)

execution_personality.network: deny (guest manifest network field is deny-only in the pilot)
execution_personality.platform: linux-userland (LiteBox inner personality) inside outer Linux sandbox
execution_personality.process: spawn (one sandboxed clone per run: user/mount/PID/net namespaces, seccomp deny-by-default, rlimits, watchdog)

kill_semantics.kill: watchdog SIGKILLs the sandboxed child on timeout; host emits final receipt
kill_semantics.state: per-run (workdir under $TMPDIR/organelle-<id>-<pid>; guest tar + manifest + receipt)
kill_semantics.suspend: no-op: runs are bounded by the guest manifest timeout_secs; a run is atomic (receipt or honest failure)

provenance.valence: candidate (sandbox host; external security review open — see docs/10-10-SECURITY.md when the hardening coordinator lands it)
